facts.claim: Disney Wonder (Disney Cruise Line): Entered service 1999; 83,338 GT; 2400 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Magic class.
Disney Wonder is a cruise ship owned and operated by Disney Cruise Line, a subsidiary of the Walt Disney Company.
She is the second ship in the Disney Cruise Line fleet and the second vessel of the Magic class, following Disney Magic (1998).

catalogSpecs.description: Magic-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 1999; 83,338 GT; approx. 2,400 guests at double occupancy.
